text:
elaine: FYI customer HavenAI reported their streaming tokens/sec went to negative values intermittently after last night's rollup deploy. They see large gaps and occasional -X values in the tokensec panel :eyes:

elaine: summary from customer: 2026-03-16 23:10 UTC start of the windowed gaps, dashboards show -120, -30 tokens/sec for several 1s windows, then zeros, then normal. They say API is not impacted but billing/reporting is off.

sam: can you paste the dashboard time range + panel config? is this only TTFT/tokensec or other streaming metrics?

elaine: panel: /dashboards/streams/tokensec, window=1s, rollup=10s->1s. It looks like the rollup service changed aggregation alignment in the latest release. Only tokensec and ttft are noisy so far.

vikram: That sounds like the new aggregation-alignment flag i pushed. I added an early-exit for empty-prefixes to avoid N+1 compute. Could be a sign flip if prefix duration < 0 during rebalance.

marco: do we have customer org id + example trace id? can we repro in staging?

elaine: org: haven-452, sample trace id: trace-0a1b2c. I attached a small CSV they exported and a screenshot: https://files.redwood/haven-452/tokensec-sample.png

vikram: ok trying to reproduce locally. quick checklist: 1) check kafka consumer group offsets for rollup-aggregator, 2) inspect rollup job ckpt timestamps, 3) verify sign/float coercion in aggregator when no tokens found.

sam: command to check kafka lag: `kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group rollup-agg-haven-452`

marco: logging hint: grep for "prefix_duration" in aggregator logs. there was a bug where a missed checkpoint yields prefix_duration = -1 which then multiplies counts by -1 when we do a delta on checkpoint pairs.

vikram: reproducer i ran in staging: injected a checkpoint reset, then pushed a window with earlier timestamp; aggregator emitted negative delta. patch candidate is to clamp prefix_duration to >=0 before delta and emit metric with fallback 0.

elaine: customer asked for backfill plan and if billing will be affected. they noticed only last 2 hours are affected.

sam: we should quarantine the billing export for haven-452 for the impacted interval. cc @billing. Also run backfill using committed offsets, not current consumer positions.

vikram: quick mitigation: rolling hotfix that clamps negative durations and skips negative deltas. can we push to staging and then prod canary?

marco: deploy-bot: started rollout of rollup-agg-hotfix to staging (job/rollup-agg-hotfix) :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout to staging started by vikram at 2026-03-17T01:02:00Z.

vikram: staging verification: synthetic stream injected, no negative tokensec observed after hotfix. still investigating impact on backfill tool for windows that overlapped the reset.

elaine: customer updated ticket #12345 with raw logs and asked for ETA on backfill. suggested interim: mark their dashboard as "use live tokens (no rollup)" to avoid negatives.

sam: steps for ops to run backfill: 1) stop rollup consumer for haven-452, 2) run `rollup-backfill --org haven-452 --from 2026-03-16T22:50Z --to 2026-03-17T00:30Z --use-checkpoints` 3) verify aggregated windows non-negative, 4) resume consumer.

vikram: note: backfill tool must use original kafka offsets recorded in ckpt-store. if ckpt-store was overwritten during restart, we'll need to compute offsets from event timestamps which is slower.

elaine: customer said they can wait a few hours if we prioritize. i updated ticket with mitigation and ETA for backfill in 3-6 hours.

marco: also adding a regression test to CI that asserts no negative deltas when injecting checkpoint resets. small PR incoming.

vikram: will open PR to clamp values and add logs that detect negative-prefix events and dump a compact diagnostic (org, partition, ckpt_before, ckpt_after) to support channel.

elaine: thanks all. i'll keep the ticket updated and post if customer sees any more odd windows. :white_check_mark:
